headline: OpenAI makes the Decisions API generally available for bounded classification, routing and scoring
summary: OpenAI made the Decisions API generally available on Oct 22, 2026. The dedicated endpoint turns text, image and JSON inputs into bounded probabilities, choices or scores, currently using GPT-6 Luna; the API guide allows up to 400 questions per request and documents prompt caching and native GPT-Live integration. OpenAI lists $0.10 per million uncached input tokens and no output-token charge, subject to caching, regional and long-context terms. The company claims up to 10× lower latency than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API, but publishes no benchmark protocol in the reviewed launch materials. Independent performance, adoption and realized economic effects remain unestablished.
